verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs say it publishes Postman collections for each API version. A Postman collection is a machine-readable API description that is arguably equivalent to an OpenAPI spec, but the evidence never mentions an OpenAPI/Swagger file or a direct download URL. llms.txt and the markdown docs are documentation indexes, not API specs. missing for 10: an explicitly documented downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec file, details on the format and download location, independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec is retrievable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: We publish separate collections for each API version.
